programme.title: 效廉出发吧！今天去哪玩
programme.desc: 这一趟到南投，威廉、小舜相揪到鱼池chill一下！威哥带着小舜一起到鱼池享受熟男行程，从绝美人气咖啡厅一路chill到底！甚至把五星料理搬上游艇，用全新视角畅游日月潭！两人逛伊达绍老街，一路遇粉丝老板热情招待，超美味总统鱼酥卷，不用进大餐厅就能吃的到！拳头大的高丽菜包让怕烫的威哥大口吃！鱼池这里竟然有媲美荷兰羊角村的美景？还有会跳舞的土地，让威廉差点深陷泥沼？！千万不要错过，更多精彩内容请锁定东森超视33频道周日晚间8点「效廉 出发吧！」。

programme.title: Frozen Planet S01
programme.desc: Spring brings warmth and life to planet's magical ice worlds. Male adelie penguins arrive in Antarctica to build their nests - it takes a good property to attract the best mates and the males will stop at nothing to better their rivals! A woolly bear caterpillar emerges from the snow having spent the winter frozen solid. Caterpillars normally become moths within months of hatching, but life is so harsh here that the woolly bear takes 14 years to reach adulthood.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S01
programme.desc: In the next phase of Ash Dykes' adventure, he sets out to explore one of the oldest Great Walls at Zhangjiakou, fortified by eight consecutive dynasties. Along the way, there's a brief detour to carve up the fresh powder on the black runs at Chongli. Dykes then immerses himself in the footsteps of centuries-old explorers at Wulouggou before tracing the Great Wall to its intersection with the Yellow River-a symbolic convergence of Chinese history and nature.

programme.title: Earth S01

programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: 梁上君子
programme.desc: 本片为徐虾导演。 董骠, 钱小豪及蒋金饰扒手, 惟董失手被捕; 董出狱后装南洋阔客, 随钱及蒋返家, 因为想扮相古怪, 惹途人围观, 三人乘机施妙手, 更向盘问的保安队长罗莽自诩身份特殊, 使罗躬身谢罪...

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: A fearless fighter, Chou Lian Huan has risen to power in Shanghai with his exceptional combat skills. He risks his life for hostess Shen Ju Fang and embarks on a series of fierce battles against the son of a notorious triad leader and his gang, ultimately becoming a scapegoat in the gang's deadly turf war.

programme.title: 仇连环
programme.desc: 仇连环在上海滩以拳头打出天下，乃好勇斗狠的典型人物。仇为了交际花沈菊芳不惜豁出性命，与著名帮会首脑之子及同伴展开连场明争暗斗，亦成为帮会争夺地盘的嫁祸目标。

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident…

programme.title: 人皮灯笼
programme.desc: 赵春方曾于决斗败于龙帅之手下。七年后，龙帅为在赏灯大会上夺魁，往寻赵春方代为制造别致灯笼。赵春方藉此暗中布下复仇大计。龙帅之妻无固失踪后，他惊闻有关人皮灯笼的传说，并开始怀疑赵春方与失踪事件有关......

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: Qing enforcer Luo Yi Hu murders rebel Chen Gui, forcing his wife and daughter Xiao Wei to flee to Guang Long Town. There, mischievous Jia Yu discovers his master's identity as a rebel while helping Xiao Wei. After his loved ones and mentor are killed, Jia Yu sheds his playful ways and seeks vengeance, facing the Qing forces in a final battle.

programme.title: 广东靓仔玉
programme.desc: 清廷高手骆一虎杀害反清义士陈贵，陈妻偕女小薇逃往广龙镇。镇上两家武馆势成水火，何教头之侄家玉生性调皮，因营救小薇识破了老师为反清首领的身份。随着至亲与恩师相继丧命于骆一虎之手，原本好胜顽皮的家玉愤而承担起复仇重任，与清廷势力展开生死决战。

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: 包剪石沓
programme.desc: 幽默风趣的爱情喜剧，三个年青医生常开道、史瑞科、萧而可，被安排追求院长的三个女儿灵珍、灵珊、灵玲。三人以「包、剪、搥」来决定追求对象，他们的追女桥段层出不穷，用尽英雄救美、苦肉计、死缠烂打等爱情药方，却全部失灵，乌龙百出...

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagle's own son Shih Yen-peh vows to avenge for his father...

programme.title: 至尊一剑
programme.desc: 魔山派秦五新剑术高超，连败九十九名剑手，终在最后一击败在剑神手上。五新知其欠缺一柄宝剑，遂杀死著名铸剑师老鹰，夺取稀世的「老鹰宝剑」。老鹰之子燕北悲痛万分，矢誓报仇，不自量力挑战五新，结果被打落悬崖之下...

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

programme.title: 千娇百媚
programme.desc: 有才华的女艺员兰兰与梅梅新加入「马氏歌舞团」，兰兰与团主马英不和。马英在报纸匿名征求女友，兰兰与他以匿名用书信往来，互生情愫。相约见面时，两人胆怯退缩。歌舞团获邀到日本表演，由马英带领，兰兰担任女主角，二人的关系可否趁机会发展？

programme.title: Duel Of Fist
programme.desc: Fan Ke discovers at his father's deathbed that he has a half-brother, Wenlie, in Thailand. He goes to find Wenlie, who became a boxer to support his sick mother. Following their encounter, the two got involved in the underworld of boxing match gambling.

programme.title: 拳击
programme.desc: 范克在父亲临终时发现自己有一个同父异母的兄弟汶烈在泰国。于是，他去找汶烈，并发现他为了救治重病中的母亲，而成为一名拳手。两人相遇后，更被牵连在地下拳击赌博当中。

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the City of Liu are forced to flee when the vicious Black Tigers gang raids their city, but are able to hide all their gold and treasures in a valley. A team of swordswomen led by Liu wants to get their hands on the treasures before the bandits, but both parties will have to contend with the wandering swordsman Chou for them...

programme.title: 大罗剑侠
programme.desc: 女侠明珠的师父遭黑虎帮歹徒偷袭重伤，临终嘱往找故友之女青青，探问失踪财宝。歹徒偷听得遗言，先去劫走青青，途遇「大罗剑侠」周应龙，怒打不平……

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the family's young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huo's stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: 女巡按
programme.desc: 影后李菁的代表作，萧湘反串文必正，倾慕官府小姐霍定金，卖身混入霍家，二人私定终身，必正被陷害入狱，定金设法营救...

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his “Crazy Lo Han Fist” improves with every fight.

programme.title: 佛都有火
programme.desc: 故事讲述，某寺青年僧人「疯子」，性格疯疯癫癫，行为全不符僧人规范。该寺主持玄明方丈却认为「疯子」与佛有缘，并因应其性格与气质，授以「癫罗汉拳」。「疯子」有了武功后，动辄出拳伤人，方丈只得将其逐出寺门...

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back…

programme.title: 我为你狂
programme.desc: 的士司机阿发与少女阿霞相爱已久，但发有神经错乱，霞为除心理负担，忍痛分手; 发大闹霞家并断指示真心，令霞感动而复合。然发却不务正业，令霞甚为反感;一次争执间，发狂性大发，霞流产，再次离开发...

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: 看不见的他们
programme.desc: 一场车祸后，林月家里怪事连连。全身冰冷的姐姐在镜子里看不见家人的身影，黑夜里爸爸窥探的双眼，和每天凌晨阁楼传来的弹珠声。林月循声而上去寻找真相，却在打开阁楼的门后，发现里面紧锁的是自己的遗像…

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: 少年叶问之危机时刻
programme.desc: 1917年，少年叶问初到香港求学。英文演讲比赛当天，学校发生一宗惊天绑架案，全校同学都被挟持。面对眼前的危机，叶问挺身而出，发现绑匪竟然是自己的师父和好兄弟。少年叶问在危机时刻可否打败绑匪，从而伸张正义？

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip’s boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim’s sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist’s drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: 法中情
programme.desc: 摄影师田迪文强奸模特儿凌祖儿，幸得大律师叶颖文洗脱控罪。颖文男友高级督察方伟负责此案，不满女友是非不分。祖儿之妹凌珊珊替姐报仇，反遭田施暴，颖文再任其辩护律师。珊珊因过往不良纪录，处处失利，能够令田入罪的机会极微；检控官决定请师兄龙约翰出山相助。

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: 激战
programme.desc: 曾经叱咤世界拳坛的拳王程辉，在澳门遇见了热血青年思齐。随着他训练思齐备战即将举行的混合格斗赛，程辉不仅重燃了对拳击的热爱，还重新找回了对生命的热情，并更加珍惜那些在生命中真正重要的人。

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: 爱的世界
programme.desc: 李子良丧妻后，与两个儿子相依为命。妻子的巨额医药费令子良经济十分拮据，受同事教唆往马场孤注一掷，迫得向高利贷借款，从此子良债台高筑，疲于奔命，没有时间与儿子沟通，父子疏离。与此同时高利贷不断登门恐吓，骚扰儿子，最终弄至悲剧发生…

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: 赌城大亨之新哥传奇
programme.desc: 取材自澳门赌王何鸿燊的真人真事，讲述由1930至1960年代赌王努力打拼至事业高峰的故事。1941年日本入侵香港，年青大学生贺新逃离香港奔赴澳门。贺新起初在码头做苦力，凭着他的胆色过人、刻苦耐劳和聪明机智，最终登上澳门博彩业的第一把交椅。

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: 珠光宝气
programme.desc: 一名商人的私生女，无意中擦出神仙阿宝，并得到三个愿望。可惜阿宝法术不精，而发生了很多啼笑皆非的事。

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: 头文字 D
programme.desc: 本片由日本同名殿堂级漫画改编而成。故事描述十八岁的拓海，每天驾驶着父亲残旧的汽车送递豆腐，却无意中练得一手出神入化的飘移技术。拓海被父亲怂恿参加山路赛，竟在众人错愕之下胜出，一夜成名，之后更面对一连串惊险绝伦的挑战赛！

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic message in a bottle sends Taiwanese girl Ah Bu on a quest to Hong Kong to find its author, Albert. Disheartened when he turns out to be nothing like she imagined, she prepares to return home. However, her plans take an unexpected turn when she encounters Chan, a wealthy tycoon, and an unlikely romance begins to bloom.

programme.title: 玻璃樽
programme.desc: 台湾女孩阿不前往香港，寻找漂流玻璃樽中那封浪漫纸条的作者阿拔。谁料现实阿拔与幻想的相差甚远，让她心碎失望、决定黯然返乡。就在命运的转角，她遇上富豪企业家陈子午，就此展开一段意想不到的爱情故事。

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law’s affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered and cremated. When Song finally returns home, he takes the case to court but the judge brushes it aside and closes it abruptly. Can Song finally avenge his brother’s death?

programme.title: 武松斗杀西门庆
programme.desc: 武松因发现他的嫂子潘金莲与富家子弟西门庆有染，而被西门庆设计将他流放一年，在此期间，他的哥哥武大郎不幸被杀并火化下葬。武松回家后，告上公堂，谁知县令三言两语打回状子，潦草结案。武松最终能否为哥哥报仇？

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: 替身纸人
programme.desc: 警方在调查一宗团伙杀人案时，突然又发生了离奇的纸人杀人事件，嫌疑人一个接一个被杀。随着不断挖出的线索，警方最终发现这背后隐藏着横跨两代人的秘密与悲剧。

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar’s gang when he saves the gang’s elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: 武状元苏乞儿
programme.desc: 苏乞儿原为贵族，但因上京考武状元时作弊，被眨为乞儿。苏乞儿在机缘巧合下救了丐帮长老，并接任为新帮主。一天，皇上狩猎之时，差点被暗杀，幸苏乞儿及时救驾。皇帝欲恢复其官职时，苏乞儿却拒绝。其后，皇上御赐一个乞儿钵予苏乞儿，从此他过着愉快的行乞生活。

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: 僵尸家族
programme.desc: 一群盗墓的考古学家意外发现一个保存完好的僵尸家族，计画将他们贩卖至黑市牟利。岂料在运送途中，不慎撕下封印僵尸的纸符，让沉睡的亡灵苏醒逃窜。然而，当地中医师林正英挺身而出，誓要将它们彻底剿灭。

programme.title: The Bullet Vanishes
programme.desc: A series of murders at a munitions factory sparks fear of a “Phantom Bullet” that kills without a trace. Detective Song Dong Lu and sharpshooter Guo Zhui are tasked with solving the case. As they uncover layers of corruption and conspiracy, they are drawn into a deadly game where the truth is more dangerous than the bullets.

programme.title: 消失的子弹
programme.desc: 民国初年，一家兵工厂发生离奇连环命案。死者皆死于枪击，现场却遍寻不到弹头，引发幽灵子弹索命恐慌。警政官松东路与热血神枪手郭追受命联手侦破此案。随着调查深入，两人发现阿森纳内黑幕重重，而真相竟隐藏在一个关于正义与人性堕落的惊人诡计之中。

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: 靓女差馆
programme.desc: 雷女警长率领的港岛东刑事侦缉组的组员全是女警，因此有「靓女差馆」之称。警员生啤和沙爹对各女警一见难忘，遂主动申请调职到靓女差馆，意图接近众女并展开追求。这时，靓女差馆收到炸弹恐吓，她们最后能化解危机吗？

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter’s company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: 盲战
programme.desc: 前特警队长东谷在任务中罹患永久性失明，之后更被胁迫要承担任务失败的责任。幸好东谷在女儿的陪伴下逐渐走出阴霾，并开始适应黑暗的世界。可是曾经的宿敌再度出现，令女儿陷入危险之中。东谷为救女儿，展开了一场生死盲战。

programme.title: Global Watch
programme.desc: GLOBAL WATCH is a 60 minute-long news program. The show stresses Chinese elements, emphasizing China’s perspective, policies and stories. The program, relying on global reporting resources, presents in-depth analysis and coverage of major global issues, from a Chinese perspective on international affairs. The program presents to-the-point interpretation of Chinese policies and stories that are of interest to foreign audiences, in a style they are familiar with.

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the world’s top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: Sports Scene
programme.desc: Sports Scene brings you closer to all the action from all corners of the world, with highlights from across Europe, North America and China's top sports leagues. We examine the changes and growth in China's domestic leagues, as the country undergoes an incredible economic transformation. Our exclusive features, "Tackling China", "CBA Stories", and "Beyond the Baseline", take you behind the scenes and closer to the top athletes in China, by providing a unique perspective on the top sports stories

programme.title: Rediscovering China
programme.desc: Rediscovering China is a half-hour documentary program on CGTN. Each edition offers unique insight into various aspects of life in China today. With unrivalled access to the country's people and places, the program aims to show the global audience an inclusive and vigorous China.

programme.title: Country Spirit
programme.desc: KOO SAI LUNG (CHUN PUI) is the manager of a wine factory. He adopts his ex-girlfriend’s illegitimate son, SHUNG (LAM KA TUNG), out of kindness. SHUNG is cheerful and tolerates any kind of abuse. LUNG’s sister, YIU (TANG SHUI MAN), loves SHUNG. However, she cannot forget her former love KOU (TSANG WAI KUEN) who is dead.

programme.title: 酒是故乡醇
programme.desc: 古世龙(秦沛)乃酒厂当家，因顾念情义而收留旧情人的私生子阿纯(林家栋)。纯寄人篱下，饱受屈辱，幸其生性豁达，毫不介意任低微的「酒尾公」。世龙妹古瑶(邓萃雯)处处关怀纯，纯对瑶早生情愫，惜瑶念念不忘已逝世的蒸煮师傅裘真(曾伟权)，不能释怀。世龙独子桂生(马德钟)为国从军，音讯杳然，古家以为其已死，替他安排冥婚，新娘是以拉横水渡为生的黎顺风(佘诗曼)。顺风为人执着、硬朗，与古家上下皆合不来，幸得纯从旁劝解，人才像美酒经过蒸酿般越见醇厚。纯其后拜「火王」金吉祥(元华)为师；祥早期丧妻，与瑶同病相怜，发展成一对斗气冤家。世龙中风，古家内部争权夺利，闹得天翻地覆，风只好以大少奶身分担起当家之位，与纯合力助酒厂渡过难关。二人日久生情，岂料生却于此时突然回家。风已为人妻，纯重情义，二人能否冲破沉重的道德枷锁，以真爱酿出醉人美酒？

programme.title: My Unfair Lady
programme.desc: Career driven LING MAN (Jessica Hester Hsuan) is a property management executive with a golden touch, and the shopping malls under her leadership have won many awards. She is also a control freak. As her number one assistant, her cousin LING YU-KEN (Natalie Tong) is totally under her thumb and hard-working. She learns to flirt superficially, helping LING MAN smooth over many problems. Just as LING MAN is looking forward to moving up the company to be appointed to the board of directors, the comp

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏(宣萱)旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤(唐诗咏)作为她的头号助手，唯命是从、任劳任怨，更练出「伪撒娇」本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦。正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深(林文龙)与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号「上海撒破郎」的美女实习生田蜜(高海宁)接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超(黎诺懿)北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖(王浩信)，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇、能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？

programme.title: The Airport Diary
programme.desc: Since relocation to Chek Lap Kok in 1998, passenger traffic at Hong Kong International Airport has increased threefold in twenty-five years. And Yeung Sheung-wai (Kenneth Ma), who started out as a clerk, has been promoted to IAC Duty Manager. He is tasked with overseeing the operations of the airport. Sheung-wai also has a contingent of amicable partners, including his assistant-cum-admirer Fong Ho-yee (Rosita Kwok), Lui Chi-shan (Samantha Ko) – who handles airport passenger services – Chan Kit

programme.title: 飞常日志
programme.desc: 香港国际机场自九八年迁往赤鱲角，廿五年来客运量攀升三倍，杨尚伟(马国明饰)亦从小职员晋升为中央控制中心值班经理，负责监察整个机场的运作。尚伟还有一班好伙伴，包括仰慕他的助手方可儿(郭柏姸饰)、负责机场客运服务的吕芷珊(高海宁饰)、负责机场保安的陈杰(洪永城饰)及负责停机坪服务的李胜祥(徐荣饰)，他们合作无间协助处理机场发生的各种事情……尚伟与身为港湾航空驻机场主管的前妻张若玲(蔡思贝饰)常有交集，其实二人离婚后仍想着对方，当中机长郭启光(朱敏瀚饰)和空服员高雅雯(刘颖旋饰)的出现，令二人关系再起波澜。

programme.title: Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: The founder and first emperor of the Ming Dynasty CHU YUEN-CHEUNG has passed away. CHU WAN-MAN (Chan Shan Chung), who is the son of his designated heir, is made his successor. MAN’s bodyguard NGO SIU-FUNG (Michael Tse) is ordered to search for CHEUNG’s lost will. In the course of his investigation, he gets to know the Prince of Yin CHU TAI’s (Joe Ma) counselor MA SAM-PO (Sammul Chan). FUNG and PO appreciate each other, but FUNG reminds himself not to drop his guard, as TAI is coveting the throne

programme.title: 洪武三十二
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆(陈山聪)，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风(谢天华)奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣(马德钟)的得力谋臣马三保(陈键锋)，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心。笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱(江若琳)却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备。失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三(徐子珊)和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中……

programme.title: Line Walker
programme.desc: Following the death of his co-worker, CHEUK HOI (Michael Mui) discovers that five undercover officers have lost. All of them possess confidential information. CHEUK HOI needs to find them immediately……

programme.desc: 古世龙(秦沛)乃酒厂当家，因顾念情义而收留旧情人的私生子阿纯(林家栋)。纯寄人篱下，饱受屈辱，幸其生性豁达，毫不介意任低微的「酒尾公」。世龙妹古瑶(邓萃雯)处处关怀纯，纯对瑶早生情愫，惜瑶念念不忘已逝世的蒸煮师傅裘真(曾伟权)，不能释怀。世龙独子桂生(马德钟)为国从军，音讯杳然，古家以为其已死，替他安排冥婚，新娘是以拉横水渡为生的黎顺风(佘诗曼)。顺风为人执着、硬朗，与古家上下皆合不来，幸得纯从旁劝解，人才像美酒经过蒸酿般越见醇厚。纯其后拜「火王」金吉祥(元华)为师；祥早期丧妻，与瑶同病相怜，发展成一对斗气冤家。世龙中风，古家内部争权夺利，闹得天翻地覆，风只好以大少奶身分担起当家之位，与纯合力助酒厂渡过难关。二人日久生情，岂料生却于此时突然回家。风已为人妻，纯重情义，二人能否冲破沉重的道德枷锁，以真爱酿出醉人美酒？

programme.title: My Unfair Lady
programme.desc: Career driven LING MAN (Jessica Hester Hsuan) is a property management executive with a golden touch, and the shopping malls under her leadership have won many awards. She is also a control freak. As her number one assistant, her cousin LING YU-KEN (Natalie Tong) is totally under her thumb and hard-working. She learns to flirt superficially, helping LING MAN smooth over many problems. Just as LING MAN is looking forward to moving up the company to be appointed to the board of directors, the comp

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏(宣萱)旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤(唐诗咏)作为她的头号助手，唯命是从、任劳任怨，更练出「伪撒娇」本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦。正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深(林文龙)与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号「上海撒破郎」的美女实习生田蜜(高海宁)接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超(黎诺懿)北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖(王浩信)，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇、能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？

programme.title: The Airport Diary
programme.desc: Since relocation to Chek Lap Kok in 1998, passenger traffic at Hong Kong International Airport has increased threefold in twenty-five years. And Yeung Sheung-wai (Kenneth Ma), who started out as a clerk, has been promoted to IAC Duty Manager. He is tasked with overseeing the operations of the airport. Sheung-wai also has a contingent of amicable partners, including his assistant-cum-admirer Fong Ho-yee (Rosita Kwok), Lui Chi-shan (Samantha Ko) – who handles airport passenger services – Chan Kit

programme.title: 飞常日志
programme.desc: 香港国际机场自九八年迁往赤鱲角，廿五年来客运量攀升三倍，杨尚伟(马国明饰)亦从小职员晋升为中央控制中心值班经理，负责监察整个机场的运作。尚伟还有一班好伙伴，包括仰慕他的助手方可儿(郭柏姸饰)、负责机场客运服务的吕芷珊(高海宁饰)、负责机场保安的陈杰(洪永城饰)及负责停机坪服务的李胜祥(徐荣饰)，他们合作无间协助处理机场发生的各种事情……尚伟与身为港湾航空驻机场主管的前妻张若玲(蔡思贝饰)常有交集，其实二人离婚后仍想着对方，当中机长郭启光(朱敏瀚饰)和空服员高雅雯(刘颖旋饰)的出现，令二人关系再起波澜。

programme.title: Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: The founder and first emperor of the Ming Dynasty CHU YUEN-CHEUNG has passed away. CHU WAN-MAN (Chan Shan Chung), who is the son of his designated heir, is made his successor. MAN’s bodyguard NGO SIU-FUNG (Michael Tse) is ordered to search for CHEUNG’s lost will. In the course of his investigation, he gets to know the Prince of Yin CHU TAI’s (Joe Ma) counselor MA SAM-PO (Sammul Chan). FUNG and PO appreciate each other, but FUNG reminds himself not to drop his guard, as TAI is coveting the throne

programme.title: 洪武三十二
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆(陈山聪)，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风(谢天华)奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣(马德钟)的得力谋臣马三保(陈键锋)，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心。笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱(江若琳)却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备。失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三(徐子珊)和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中……

programme.title: Line Walker
programme.desc: Following the death of his co-worker, CHEUK HOI (Michael Mui) discovers that five undercover officers have lost. All of them possess confidential information. CHEUK HOI needs to find them immediately……

programme.title: 使徒行者
programme.desc: 总督察卓凯(苗侨伟)因战友死亡，发现一直联系的五名卧底全部失踪，由于他们掌握高度机密，卓凯决意追寻，卧底的黑白两道身分交错复杂，人人皆宣称为正义而战，但真正的正义又是谁来主宰？

programme.desc: The founder and first emperor of the Ming Dynasty CHU YUEN-CHEUNG has passed away. CHU WAN-MAN (Chan Shan Chung), who is the son of his designated heir, is made his successor. MAN’s bodyguard NGO SIU-FUNG (Michael Tse) is ordered to search for CHEUNG’s lost will. In the course of his investigation, he gets to know the Prince of Yin CHU TAI’s (Joe Ma) counselor MA SAM-PO (Sammul Chan). FUNG and PO appreciate each other, but FUNG reminds himself not to drop his guard, as TAI is coveting the throne

programme.title: 洪武三十二
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆(陈山聪)，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风(谢天华)奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣(马德钟)的得力谋臣马三保(陈键锋)，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心。笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱(江若琳)却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备。失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三(徐子珊)和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中……

programme.title: Line Walker
programme.desc: Following the death of his co-worker, CHEUK HOI (Michael Mui) discovers that five undercover officers have lost. All of them possess confidential information. CHEUK HOI needs to find them immediately……

programme.title: 使徒行者
programme.desc: 总督察卓凯(苗侨伟)因战友死亡，发现一直联系的五名卧底全部失踪，由于他们掌握高度机密，卓凯决意追寻，卧底的黑白两道身分交错复杂，人人皆宣称为正义而战，但真正的正义又是谁来主宰？

programme.title: Country Spirit
programme.desc: KOO SAI LUNG (CHUN PUI) is the manager of a wine factory. He adopts his ex-girlfriend’s illegitimate son, SHUNG (LAM KA TUNG), out of kindness. SHUNG is cheerful and tolerates any kind of abuse. LUNG’s sister, YIU (TANG SHUI MAN), loves SHUNG. However, she cannot forget her former love KOU (TSANG WAI KUEN) who is dead.

programme.title: 酒是故乡醇
programme.desc: 古世龙(秦沛)乃酒厂当家，因顾念情义而收留旧情人的私生子阿纯(林家栋)。纯寄人篱下，饱受屈辱，幸其生性豁达，毫不介意任低微的「酒尾公」。世龙妹古瑶(邓萃雯)处处关怀纯，纯对瑶早生情愫，惜瑶念念不忘已逝世的蒸煮师傅裘真(曾伟权)，不能释怀。世龙独子桂生(马德钟)为国从军，音讯杳然，古家以为其已死，替他安排冥婚，新娘是以拉横水渡为生的黎顺风(佘诗曼)。顺风为人执着、硬朗，与古家上下皆合不来，幸得纯从旁劝解，人才像美酒经过蒸酿般越见醇厚。纯其后拜「火王」金吉祥(元华)为师；祥早期丧妻，与瑶同病相怜，发展成一对斗气冤家。世龙中风，古家内部争权夺利，闹得天翻地覆，风只好以大少奶身分担起当家之位，与纯合力助酒厂渡过难关。二人日久生情，岂料生却于此时突然回家。风已为人妻，纯重情义，二人能否冲破沉重的道德枷锁，以真爱酿出醉人美酒？
